name: CyberMetric
description: CyberMetric is a suite of multiple-choice question-answering benchmark datasets designed to evaluate the general cybersecurity knowledge of large language models, covering topics such as cryptography, reverse engineering, and risk assessment.
reputation: A recent cybersecurity knowledge benchmark that has been used to probe LLMs on domain-specific multiple-choice questions, but it is still emerging rather than broadly standardized.
notes: Datasets range from 80 to 10,000 questions; questions validated by human experts; includes human baseline comparisons.
